summary.headline: Turin Astrological Codices
summary.text: Catalog entries for two Turin paper codices: a 16th-century manuscript of John Kamateros’s iambic astrological synopsis for the emperor Porphyrogenitus, followed by clarification of establishing themata and genethlia; and an unfinished 15th-century codex with zodiacal divisions, stellar-motion tables, and astronomical material.
